_schema: Run29 s3 Phase-3 pairing (claude -p opus). Tests v2 no-analog hypothesis. preliminary_gap_guess is PRE-verification.

candidates.technique: OmniVTA: Visuo-Tactile World Modeling for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation
candidates.craft: Hedgelaying pleacher cut (cutting/bending stems near-horizontal while leaving them alive)
candidates.has_industrial_analog: no + no factory process partially severs and lays living stems into a stock-proof living fence; mechanical hedge cutters only trim
candidates.capability_gap: No system predicts how much bark/sapwood hinge to leave so a partially-cut stem bends to near-horizontal WITHOUT snapping and stays alive — the tacit 'how far can I bend this stem' contact judgment varying per stem/species.
candidates.differentiator_justification: OmniVTA's two-stream world model predicts short-horizon contact evolution from tactile+visual state — exactly the unmade prediction of fracture-vs-survival under a bending cut. A generic VLM cannot feel the hinge; the tactile world-model IS the differentiator.
candidates.preliminary_gap_guess: OPEN — no industrial analog, no funded research-AI on living-fence laying, no app; pure kinesthetic white space.
candidates.search_probe: "hedgelaying" OR "pleacher" (machine learning OR robot OR tactile OR "bend without breaking") living stem

candidates.technique: kooplearn (Scikit-Learn Compatible Library for Evolution Operator Learning)
candidates.craft: Solera capataz extraction-timing judgment (deciding when/how much wine to draw via venencia tasting)
candidates.has_industrial_analog: no - the dynamic fractional-blending decision driven by venencia tasting is a bespoke cellar-master judgment with no automated equivalent
candidates.capability_gap: No model captures the criaderas-y-solera fractional-blending system as a dynamical operator to predict how a given saca timing/volume perturbs the solera's steady-state character — currently only a by-palate decision.
candidates.differentiator_justification: The criaderas-y-solera is a canonical evolution-operator/transfer-operator system; kooplearn learns the Koopman operator and its spectrum from cask data, directly forecasting character drift under withdrawal — a capability no tasting-note or forecasting model provides.
candidates.preliminary_gap_guess: OPEN — no industrial analog, no app, and no prior Koopman/AI treatment of solera dynamics found.
candidates.search_probe: (solera OR "criaderas" OR sherry) ("Koopman" OR "dynamical model" OR "machine learning") fractional blending extraction

candidates.technique: OmniVTA: Visuo-Tactile World Modeling for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation
candidates.craft: Nerikoh (Japanese kneaded incense) blending 'by feel' and maturation judgment
candidates.has_industrial_analog: no - artisanal kneaded-incense composition is taught through long apprenticeship and tuned by tactile/olfactory feel; no automated process composes or judges nerikoh maturation

candidates.differentiator_justification: OmniVTA's self-supervised tactile encoder + contact-aware world model targets exactly the kneading-consistency feel; the differentiator is haptic state prediction, not any visual or odor proxy.
candidates.preliminary_gap_guess: OPEN — no analog, no app, no funded research-AI; kneaded-incense tactile judgment is untouched white space.
candidates.search_probe: (nerikoh OR "kneaded incense" OR "練香") (tactile OR "machine learning" OR robot OR kneading consistency)

candidates.technique: Machine learning for smell: Ordinal odor strength prediction of molecular perfumery components
candidates.craft: Kodo monkoh / kumiko scent-discernment ('listening to incense' and identifying materials)
candidates.has_industrial_analog: no - the incense-appreciation/identification art has no industrial or automated analog; it is a cultivated human sensory practice (geido)
candidates.capability_gap: No model maps aromatic-wood (jinkoh/kyara) volatile profiles to the discriminative 'identify-this-material' judgment trained in the kumiko guessing game.
candidates.differentiator_justification: The odor-strength work's molecular-encoding→perception pipeline is the only fresh structure-to-olfaction learner that can be retargeted to incense-material discrimination; smell-ML is the differentiator, not a backbone.
candidates.preliminary_gap_guess: OPEN — no analog, no app, no funded research-AI on kodo; caveat: odor-strength predicts strength not identity, so transfer is non-trivial.

candidates.technique: OmniVTA: Visuo-Tactile World Modeling for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation
candidates.craft: Bonsai wiring (gauge selection and bending choreography to reposition branches)
candidates.has_industrial_analog: no - no industrial wire-forming process trains a living branch over months while judging bark scarring; it is a hands-on craft skill

candidates.differentiator_justification: This is a contact-rich living-material bending task; OmniVTA's tactile world-model predicting contact/deformation evolution is the differentiator over image-only bonsai concept generators.
candidates.preliminary_gap_guess: OPEN — no analog, no wiring app/robot, ai very-low; tactile branch-training is white space.
candidates.search_probe: bonsai wiring (robot OR "machine learning" OR tactile OR branch bending stiffness gauge selection)

candidates.has_industrial_analog: no - Cognac assemblage by the maitre de chai is an inherently bespoke human sensory craft; no automated process composes the eaux-de-vie blend by judgment (houses market it as artisanal/hand-assembled)

candidates.craft: Flue-pipe voicing by hand (cutup, flueway, toe adjustment for timbre/volume/attack)
candidates.has_industrial_analog: no - voicing is performed one pipe at a time by a specialist voicer on bespoke, one-off instruments; there is no mass-production line that voices flue pipes by formula
candidates.capability_gap: No closed-form law maps the voicer's geometric tweaks (cutup height, flueway depth, toe diameter) to target timbre/volume/attack — the mapping exists only as the voicer's ear-judged feel.
candidates.differentiator_justification: SymTorch distills a trained NN's geometry→tone behavior into a human-readable equation — turning the tacit voicing LAW into a formula, which is precisely the unmade artifact; symbolic distillation is the differentiator, not generic modeling.
candidates.preliminary_gap_guess: OPEN — no industrial analog, no voicing-decision app; caveat: organ-acoustics academic models exist (jet-lip), probe whether any yields a voicing formula.
candidates.search_probe: ("organ pipe" voicing OR "flue pipe") ("symbolic regression" OR equation OR "machine learning") cutup flueway toe timbre

candidates.technique: OmniVTA: Visuo-Tactile World Modeling for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation
candidates.craft: Pressure-flaking force/termination control (feathering vs. hinge/step termination)
candidates.has_industrial_analog: no + no manufacturing process shapes objects by hand-pressure detachment of conchoidal flakes; closest brittle-material industry (glass scoring/sawing) uses unrelated mechanics
candidates.capability_gap: No system predicts, from in-hand pressure direction/magnitude and biface positioning, whether a flake will feather-terminate vs leave a hinge/step — the fine haptic loop that defines the skill.
candidates.differentiator_justification: OmniVTA's contact-evolution world-model targets the haptic feathering-vs-hinge prediction directly; tactile differentiator over the existing geometry-only knapping CGAN.
candidates.preliminary_gap_guess: NARROW — no analog, but knapping already has a research CGAN for flake prediction; pressure-flaking termination specifically may still be unmodeled.
candidates.search_probe: (knapping OR "pressure flaking" OR lithic) (tactile OR haptic OR "machine learning") hinge feather termination force

candidates.technique: kooplearn (Scikit-Learn Compatible Library for Evolution Operator Learning)
candidates.craft: Comb/rake stroke as chaotic-advection control (stretching-and-folding the size to a target figure)
candidates.has_industrial_analog: no + chaotic-advection mixing is studied industrially in stirred tanks, but no factory process renders a controlled marbled FIGURE on a liquid surface for product; the figural patterning has no industrial counterpart
candidates.capability_gap: No model maps a comb-stroke sequence to the resulting marbled figure (bouquet/peacock) on a real bath — the stretch-and-fold mapping under sensitive-to-initial-conditions chaotic advection.
candidates.differentiator_justification: Koopman/transfer-operator learning linearizes the stretch-fold advection dynamics into a predictable operator — the right tool for chaotic-advection forward prediction; kooplearn is the differentiator over digital marbling sims.
candidates.preliminary_gap_guess: NARROW — no industrial figural analog, but marbling has digital-sim apps and CFD literature; chaotic-advection ML may collide.
candidates.search_probe: (marbling OR ebru OR suminagashi) ("chaotic advection" OR Koopman OR "machine learning") comb stroke pattern prediction

candidates.craft: Judging clay plasticity / water content by feel (stiffness sensed by hand, not measured)
candidates.has_industrial_analog: partial - industrial ceramics uses NIR/in-line moisture analyzers (MoistTech, Finna) to control clay moisture on production lines, but these measure bulk % moisture, not the hand-felt plasticity/workability judgment used in throwing
candidates.capability_gap: No closed-form relation expresses the 'smooth = just right' tactile setpoint in terms of the inter-particle friction/plasticity it reflects — potters explicitly reject the gauge number.
candidates.differentiator_justification: SymTorch can distill a tactile-sensor→workability NN into an interpretable plasticity equation, converting the tacit feel into a teachable law; symbolic distillation differentiates from bulk-% NIR sensing.
candidates.preliminary_gap_guess: NARROW — partial industrial analog (NIR moisture) means a prior detection front exists, though the hand-feel law is likely unmodeled.
candidates.search_probe: (clay OR ceramic) plasticity ("machine learning" OR "symbolic regression" OR tactile) workability throwing water content feel

candidates.craft: Free-reed (harmonium/reed-organ) tuning by filing the reed tongue
candidates.has_industrial_analog: partial - factory reed instruments (accordions/harmoniums) are made at scale, but final fine tuning/voicing of individual reeds is still done by hand filing, not an automated industrial step
candidates.capability_gap: No formula gives how much metal to remove and where (tip=flat, base=sharp) per reed to hit a pitch given the irreversible nature of over-removal — done entirely by manual judgment.
candidates.differentiator_justification: SymTorch distills a geometry/mass→pitch-shift NN into a closed-form filing law, the exact unmade decision aid; symbolic regression is the differentiator over generic tuner apps.
candidates.preliminary_gap_guess: NARROW — partial industrial analog in reed manufacture and reed-acoustics models may already give a tuning relation; verify.
candidates.search_probe: ("free reed" OR harmonium OR accordion) reed tuning ("symbolic regression" OR equation OR "machine learning") filing pitch tip base
